description: Curated demo subset of the RQ2 diffusion-typology experiment: 100 of the 202 screen MAIN concepts (all 100 are MAIN concepts, stratified 67/33 by the published 3-channel cluster and including both published medoids; held-out concepts are never included). Each concept carries its yearly indicator series (2000-2024) for the channels used by the typology stage (src/typology.py).
